system_prompt:
You are the promo editor for a vertical microdrama app (think ReelShort / DramaBox ads on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts). You cut 20-60 second promos straight from the show to pull in viewers who have never seen it.

A great promo:
1. OPENS ON A HOOK: the first 3 seconds must stop a scrolling thumb — a slap, a shocking line, a public humiliation, a reveal, a threat, a kiss, a betrayal. Never open on scenery, walking, or a calm establishing shot.
2. ENDS ON A CLIFFHANGER: cut on an unresolved moment — a threat hanging, a question unanswered, a reveal about to land, a door bursting open. Never end after the tension resolves.
3. MAKES SENSE ON ITS OWN: a stranger with zero context understands who is wronged and what is at stake within the clip.

You will receive the series bible (for your understanding only) and the screenplays of one or more episodes as timestamped beats. Each episode starts with a line "EPISODE <number>":
[BEAT_ID start-end KIND] text
KIND is CAM (camera), ACT (action), SFX (sound), or a SPEAKER (emotion) for dialogue. Timestamps are MM:SS.s from the episode start. Camera/action/dialogue beats overlap in time.

Do the following for EACH episode separately (a promo window never crosses episodes):

A) Propose 2-4 continuous promo windows (one unbroken stretch each), best first. For each:
   - "start_beat": the beat the clip starts on. It must be the hook beat or start at most 3 seconds before it.
   - "end_beat": the beat the clip ends on. Pick the cliffhanger beat itself.
   - "hook_beat": the beat that is the hook (prefer the dialogue line or action that IS the shock).
   - "cliff_beat": the cliffhanger beat (usually the same as end_beat).
   - The window from start_beat's start to end_beat's end MUST be 20-60 seconds (aim for 30-45). Compute it from the timestamps.
   - "hook": quote or describe the hook in <= 15 words. "cliffhanger": the unresolved moment in <= 15 words.
   - "why": ONE line on why a stranger would stop and then need the next episode.
   - "context_needed": what (if anything) a stranger would miss; "" if none.
   - "title": a 3-6 word internal label.
   Windows should not mostly overlap each other. If the episode genuinely has only one strong window, return one.

B) List "moments": the episode's 2-5 strongest standalone beats, each typed "hook" (would work as the first 3 seconds of an ad) or "cliff" (would work as the last beat of an ad), with a <= 12 word "note". These are used later to stitch multi-moment promos across episodes.

Return ONLY JSON, with one entry per episode you received:
{"episodes": [
  {"episode": <number>,
   "candidates": [{"title": "", "start_beat": "", "end_beat": "", "hook_beat": "", "cliff_beat": "", "hook": "", "cliffhanger": "", "why": "", "context_needed": ""}],
   "moments": [{"beat": "", "type": "hook|cliff", "note": ""}]}
]}

Use ONLY beat IDs that appear in that episode. Never invent IDs or timestamps.

candidates.title: Arriving At The Rustic Cottage
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room as the door groans shut.
candidates.why: A disgraced noble bride arriving at a broken-down shack makes viewers wonder how she will survive.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana was abandoned at the altar by her fiancé.

candidates.title: Finding Peace In The Storm
candidates.cliffhanger: Sitting here with him, I don't feel afraid as the fire fades to black.
candidates.why: The contrast between her ruined wedding day and finding unexpected comfort with a scarred stranger is deeply compelling.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana was abandoned at the altar.

moments.note: Juliana's shocked reaction to her new home.
Stepping across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
Juliana realizing she feels safe with the scarred stranger.

candidates.title: Gerald Mocks Fallen Juliana
candidates.hook: This is where you live now?
candidates.cliffhanger: Gerald threatens Juliana, asking where her beggar husband is.
candidates.why: The audience roots for Juliana against her cruel ex-fiancé and wants to see him get what's coming to him.
candidates.context_needed: Gerald abandoned Juliana at the altar for her sister.

candidates.title: The Scarred Husband Appears
candidates.hook: The towering scarred warrior silently towers over a terrified Gerald.
candidates.cliffhanger: Gerald flees in sheer terror as the husband stands tall.
candidates.why: Seeing the arrogant ex-fiancé instantly cower before the silent, intimidating warrior is extremely satisfying.
candidates.context_needed: Gerald is taunting Juliana's new husband.

moments.note: Gerald and his companion arrive to mock Juliana.
The silent warrior looms over a terrified Gerald.
Gerald frantically flees in terror from the cottage.

candidates.title: The Botanical Grimoire
candidates.hook: Some of the pages are ruined. Careful.
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander reveals his deep battlefield knowledge of wound-healing herbs.
candidates.why: It subverts expectations of a rough soldier and builds quiet, tender chemistry between the leads.

candidates.title: Not Yet
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana asks if his facial scars came from the war.
candidates.why: The growing intimacy and mystery behind Alexander's past make viewers want to uncover his true identity.

moments.note: Juliana touches her late mother's botanical grimoire.
Juliana asks about his war scars.

candidates.title: Saving The Sick Child
candidates.hook: Please! My boy is burning with fever!
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander warns Juliana that villagers talking about her healing skills is dangerous.
candidates.why: High stakes medical drama mixed with rising danger that connects back to the villains.

candidates.title: Whispers Of The True Duke
candidates.hook: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried.
candidates.cliffhanger: The Blond Nobleman stares into the fire, whispering 'Impossible' in growing panic.
candidates.why: The major secret identity reveal is hinted at, driving massive viewer curiosity.
candidates.context_needed: The Blond Nobleman is Gerald, who usurped the throne.

moments.note: A frantic mother begs for help with her sick child.
A rumor spreads about a scarred war veteran resembling the late Duke.
The Blond Nobleman realizes the truth in pure panic.

candidates.title: The Wounded Warrior's Scars
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana uncovers his shirt to reveal a torso covered in jagged battle scars, whispering 'Dear God.'
candidates.why: The visual shock of the brutal scars combined with raw emotional intimacy hooks viewers instantly.

candidates.title: Your Touch Is Medicine
candidates.hook: Because you are looking at me.
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander tells Juliana her touch is the only medicine that has ever eased his pain.
candidates.why: Incredible romantic tension and vulnerability that delivers a massive emotional payoff.

moments.note: Alexander returns home gravely wounded and bleeding.
Juliana gasps at the jagged scars across his torso.
Alexander confesses Juliana's touch eases his deepest pain.
